source.excerpt: Shared as an after-school check on missing work, with a topic explainer attached.

body:
## What it does

An after-school summary of what is outstanding, plus a one-off explainer on the topic whenever a Google Classroom score dips, so the follow-up is teaching rather than just a warning. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @kevinace shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
